mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_analysis_cache WHERE user_id=#{user} AND content_hash=#{hash} AND expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_analysis_cache(user_id,content_hash,result_json,expires_at) VALUES(#{userId},#{contentHash},#{resultJson},#{expiresAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE result_json=#{resultJson},expires_at=#{expiresAt}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_analysis_cache WHERE expires_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
